limitations: Automated owned-fixture checks, not unfamiliar-human acceptance.
Native file dialog is substituted to select the published owned case; real controls perform all actions.
Same Windows host, Electron zoom and a small window; no OS display/account matrix or screen-reader certification.
No live-capture behavior, performance, full qualification, hosted result or unfamiliar-user comprehension is established by this short check.
Resize/zoom dismissal was added after focused code review; it was verified after the fix, without a recorded failing pre-fix UI execution.
Recorded source/build hashes identify the tested local snapshot. Earlier hosted recovery candidate 937a19b predates these UI changes.
